description: How big a water softener you need: grains of hardness removed per day from your household size and water hardness, the grain capacity for your regeneration interval, and how often a given softener will regenerate. Formula: Grains per day = people × gallons per person per day × hardness (gpg). Capacity needed = grains per day × days between regenerations. Days between regenerations = rated capacity ÷ grains per day. gpg = mg/L ÷ 17.1.

gal_per_person_day.description: Softened water per person per day (gal); default 75

rated_capacity_grains.description: Softener capacity from its spec sheet (optional) (grains); default 0

name: calc_water_softener_size
title: Water Softener Size Calculator (Grains per Day and Capacity)
